summary: Central North Airport Group (OMA) filed a Form 6-K announcing publication of its 2025 Sustainability Report, covering ESG performance including an 88% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 carbon emissions per passenger versus 2018 baseline, 87% renewable electricity, fully electric airside shuttles at Monterrey, ACA Level 3 recertification, and reduced water consumption. The filing is routine disclosure of a sustainability report, containing no special-situation transaction, strategic review, or corporate event. No deal terms are presented. The registrant is solely a filer under Rule 13a-16. No risk-arb angle or transaction to monitor.
